name: Horror Wight
description: The Horror Wight is a small undead creature that resembles a skeletal bat with thin, tattered wings and a boney scorpion-like tail. They are quick and aggressive creatures that typically attack in packs to bring down larger creatures by attaching to them.

actions.name: Rake
actions.description: The Horror Wight swings it's sharp claws at a target dealing physical damage. If the Horror Wight is attached to the target, the attack gains a 1d4 bonus to hit.

actions.name: Bone Stinger
actions.description: If the Horror Wight is attached to a creature, it can make an attack with it's stinger against that same target, dealing physical and dark damage. This action can only be used once per turn.

actions.name: Attach
actions.description: The Horror Wight leaps up to 2 units towards a medium or larger creature and attempts to latch onto them with it's claws dealing a minimal amount of physical damage. While attached in this way, the Horror Wight can only be removed by a strength check of 8 or higher or by being destroyed.

actions.name: Glide
actions.description: After using the Move action, the Horror Wight can use it's momentum to leap into the air and glide up to 4 units of fly speed using it's pseudo wings.

traits.name: Small Profile
traits.description: While the Horror Wight is attached to a target, any attack made against it that are botched instead target the creature the wight is attached to. Additionally, the creature that the wight is attached to makes attacks against the wight with a 1d4 penalty.
